## What Is Revenue Operations?

Revenue Operations (RevOps) aligns sales, marketing, and customer success operations under a single function. Companies with RevOps report 19% faster revenue growth and 15% higher profitability.

### The RevOps Org Chart

| Role | Focus | Skills Required | Salary |
|---|---|---|---|
| RevOps Analyst | Data, reporting, tool administration | SQL, CRM, analytics | $65K-$90K |
| RevOps Manager | Process design, tool strategy | Systems thinking, Salesforce, HubSpot | $90K-$130K |
| Sr. RevOps Manager | Strategy, cross-functional alignment | Leadership, data architecture | $130K-$170K |
| Director of RevOps | Department leadership, tech stack | Strategic planning, team management | $160K-$220K |
| VP RevOps | Executive strategy, board reporting | Business strategy, data-driven decisions | $200K-$300K |
| CRO (w/ RevOps focus) | Full revenue ownership | P&L, go-to-market strategy | $280K-$500K+ |

### The RevOps Tech Stack

RevOps owns the revenue technology ecosystem:

CRM Layer : Salesforce, HubSpot

Engagement Layer : Outreach, SalesLoft, Gong

Data Layer : Snowflake, dbt, Looker

Intelligence Layer : ZoomInfo, 6sense, Clari

CPQ/Billing : DealHub, Chargebee, Zuora

Integration Layer : Workato, Tray.io

### What to Assess

#### Systems Thinking (30%)

- "Draw the data flow from lead to renewal in your current company"
- Test understanding of how systems connect
- Evaluate ability to spot inefficiencies

#### Technical Skills (25%)

- Salesforce administration (flows, reports, dashboards)
- SQL proficiency (write a query during the interview)
- Data modeling concepts
- API and integration understanding

#### Process Design (25%)

- "Design a lead scoring model for our business"
- "How would you structure the handoff from marketing to sales?"
- Evaluate process documentation quality

#### Cross-Functional Leadership (20%)

- "Sales VP and Marketing VP disagree on lead quality. How do you resolve?"
- Test influence without authority
- Assess communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders

### Common RevOps Hiring Mistakes

- Hiring a CRM admin and calling them RevOps
- Not giving RevOps enough authority to change processes
- Expecting RevOps to fix broken strategy (they fix execution)
- Under-investing in RevOps tools budget
- Hiring too junior for the scope of work

### The Career Path

RevOps professionals advance to:

- VP RevOps → CRO
- Director RevOps → VP Operations
- RevOps → GTM Strategy roles
- RevOps → SaaS consulting
